Sync tasks and quests with GitHub issues: push, pull, run, watch, status, labels

Mirror tasks, quests and their comments to GitHub issues. The repo comes from sync.github.repo in config or the git origin remote; the token from GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN or 'gh auth token'. Issues carry a woco marker so pushes are idempotent and never duplicate. With sync.github.mode set to auto (and enabled), local changes are pushed in the background right after they are made, and the daemon or 'sync watch' runs pull and push every sync.github.intervalSeconds.

```sh
woco sync <subcommand> [flags]
```

Modifies project state. Supports `--dry-run`.

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
